about_the_game:
DEMO on track for release just before NEXT-FEST Feb'06.

PSYCHO FROGO

Route it. Run it. Beat it.

Psycho Frogo is a fast, addictive “learn the line” speed-runner. Your mission is simple: figure out the best path, then speed run the best path. Every level is a tiny puzzle you can master in seconds—or grind for that perfect, brag-worthy time.

Short levels. Big dopamine. One more try… and another.

What You’ll Do

  • Scout the level, spot the cleanest route.

  • Grab speed powerups, dodge trouble, and charge for the finish.

  • Shave milliseconds, set records, unlock cool skins.

Why You’ll Love It

  • Instant fun: Jump in, restart fast, chase “just one more run."

  • Fair and readable: Everything moves when you move—no cheap hits.

  • Satisfying improvements: See your time drop as your line gets smarter.

  • Short & spicy levels: Perfect for quick sessions or long grind nights.

What’s In This Demo

A slice of levels to learn, route, and crush.

Speed boosts that feel amazing when you chain them.

Unlockable skins for showing off your best times.

If you enjoy the loop, please Wishlist and share your best times!
